name: Scholarship Struggle
source:
This game was made for the OST Jam Vol. 5 Game Jam. 

Scholarship Struggle follows Skye as she tries to find a scholarship that really nabs her interest. On her journey, she also consults her friend Adri for advice on how to handle the situation.  As you progress through the game, you can achieve 1 of  3 different endings to cap off Skye's story. 

[From [url=https://cathy-nekonin.itch.io/project-scholarship-struggle-game-jam-version]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
该游戏是为OST Jam Vol. 制作的。5游戏果酱。

《奖学金斗争》讲述了斯凯试图找到真正引起她兴趣的奖学金的故事。在旅途中，她还向朋友阿德里寻求如何处理这种情况的建议。随着游戏的进展，你可以实现3个不同结局中的一个来结束Skye的故事。

[来自[url=https://cathy-nekonin.itch.io/project-scholarship-struggle-game-jam-version]Itch.io[/url]]
